title: Greenhouse, Lever & Ashby Jobs Scraper output
description: One record per job in the default dataset, plus a SUMMARY record describing the run.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.description: Every job delivered, one record each: title, company, location, department, posting date, salary where stated, apply URL, and (optionally) the description.

summary.title: Run summary
